update.title: Ported Docklike to Wayland with live window previews
update.summary: Rebuilt Docklike’s window model around Wayland protocols, preserving grouped taskbar controls while adding asynchronous live previews for each application’s open windows.
update.previewAlt: Docklike panel menu showing live previews for two open file manager windows

blocks.body:
## Rebuild the taskbar around Wayland

Docklike now follows Wayland events for window creation, titles, application identity, state changes, activation, and removal. Application identifiers are matched to desktop entries so open windows remain grouped beneath the correct pinned launcher.

Taskbar actions—including activation, minimizing, maximizing, and closing—now operate through this Wayland-backed model.

## Add a dedicated preview pipeline

A new capture manager owns image-copy sessions, queues requests, converts compositor buffers into thumbnails, and delivers them to the panel menu. Keeping capture separate from window tracking allows one or several live previews to appear beneath an application without blocking the panel.

blocks.alt: Docklike panel menu showing live previews for two open file manager windows
blocks.caption: Each open window appears as a distinct live preview beneath its grouped application.

blocks.body:
## Preserve the Docklike workflow

Layer-shell menus remain anchored to the panel and present each application’s pinned state, grouped windows, titles, close controls, and previews. The result keeps Docklike’s compact launcher and taskbar workflow while moving its window handling to Wayland.

blocks.alt: Docklike panel demonstrating pinned applications, grouped windows, reordering, and quick switching
blocks.caption: Pinned applications, grouped windows, reordering, and quick switching remain available directly from the XFCE panel.

parts.title: Fixed Docklike hover previews and capture throttling
parts.summary: Introduced a dedicated hover state machine and fair capture scheduling so preview menus close cleanly and every visible window keeps receiving live thumbnail updates.

parts.title: Kept same-named window previews distinct
parts.summary: Connected each foreign-toplevel handle directly to its Wayfire view so windows sharing a title and application ID still receive separate capture sources.

parts.title: Fixed window preview format negotiation
parts.summary: Advertised explicit shared-memory and linear DMA-BUF formats so the compositor and capture client could agree on a frame buffer before copying a window preview.

related.title: Reduced XFCE forks while moving to 4.20
related.summary: Archived an unchanged clipboard-manager copy, rebased three focused panel patches onto XFCE 4.20, and retained the systemd-scope integration that still had no upstream equivalent.
